name: Song of Memories
source:
The game involves a mysterious virus that only infects women. In this world, the infected begin their invasion as a “new breed of humans.” The story revolves around the protagonist and the game’s heroine, a woman who harbors suspicions about the nature of the infection.

Song of Memories is a galge depicted in an adventure game-like style, but players will also be able to enjoy RPG-like battles while listening to songs. During battle, you’ll even be able to summon the five girls from the smartphone game [url=http://dream4you.jp/]Dream 4 You[/url].

[from [url=http://gematsu.com/2015/03/gal-game-song-memories-announced-ps-vita]Gematsu[/url]]
